_comment: Coverage floors (#532/#587). Up-only under test:ratchet. Floors move to two points below a level sustained for three runs; absolute floor-lag remains visible in the report.
approvedDeviation: @vitest/coverage-v8 4 (#565) made AST-aware remapping the only mode, redefining what counts as a branch (optional chaining, nullish coalescing, default params, nested arrows). This is a MEASUREMENT change, not lost coverage — proven by packages/tunnel, packages/backup, packages/agent-runtime and packages/cli, which have ZERO source or test changes vs origin/main yet all moved (tunnel branches 80 -> 52.67). Local and CI agree within 0.06pt, so it is deterministic, not runner variance. Branch floors re-seed ~1pt under the newly measured values; the vault/tunnel/cli LINE floors move 1-3pt for the same reason. NOT re-seeded downward: packages/design-tokens lines TIGHTENS 90 -> 98, because #565 added packages/design-tokens/src/css.test.ts covering toCss(), which had 0/32 lines and no test anywhere in the repo — that gap, not the remap, was the entire design-tokens lines miss (66.01 -> 99.03). Re-tightening the branch floors needs real tests and is tracked separately.
